# An eval run of the refund intent. The clerk runs on each practice case of the gold set as shadow work, and the judge grades each calibration reply.
# Case g1 asks for a refund of 80 and the people answered refund 80, so the clerk is right. Case g2 is not a request of this desk, the clerk declines, and the people sent it to a person, so the clerk is right.
# The held-out case g3 is never read in a practice run. The judge grades every reply good, and the people graded two of four replies poor, so the judge is not trusted.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec obeereal item add desk eval-refund --title 'Eval of refund' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run eval-refund desk --workflow desk/eval.star
stdout 'item eval-refund finished'

# The clerk ran on the two practice cases and not on the held-out case. The judge ran on each of the two cases and the four replies.
grep -count=2 '^clerk$' calls.log
grep -count=6 '^judge$' calls.log
! grep 'Please refund 50' last-prompt.txt

# The records are outside every work folder, one for each case and one for each reply.
exists home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g1.json
exists home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g2.json
! exists home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g3.json
exists home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/calib/r4.json
grep '"kind":"refund"' home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g1.json
grep '"amount":80' home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g1.json
grep '"kind":"none"' home/.desk/evals/eval-refund/cases/g2.json

# The score and the agreement are scripts of the desk, so the test reads them as the workflow does.
exec sh desk/evals/score.sh refund eval-refund
stdout '"accuracy": 1.000'
stdout '"mean_cost": 0.000'
exec sh desk/evals/agreement.sh refund eval-refund
stdout '"judge_trusted": false'

exec obeereal status
stdout 'eval-refund-r1\tdone'

# The mean cost is 0, so the score allows a promotion. A practice run only says so: it asks no one and opens no item.
exec obeereal item list desk
! stdout 'Promote'
! stdout 'Demote'

-- body.txt --
refund
